messages:
maya: Planning a staggered TOR switch firmware update in apac-east1 on 2026-04-07 22:00 UTC. We'll need to soft-drain GPUs on 2 racks at a time. Estimated window per cohort 35m.

ash: Which racks and how many GPUs are in-scope? Any constraint on in-region spare capacity?

li: Impact: racks r141-r146 (6 racks), ~210 GPUs. In-region spare: ~50 GPUs (saturn-edge). Cross-region spill expensive due to egress. Recommend 2-rack cohorts to limit cache churn.

maya: Ops steps: cordon 2 racks -> drain GPU jobs -> apply TOR firmware handshake -> wait 3m for link flaps -> run kv-sync for hot prefixes -> warmbackfill from saturn-edge for 10m -> uncordon -> 10m cooldown. Repeat.

ash: Can we canary the first cohort on a less-active rack earlier same day?

li: Yes, schedule staging-canary at 21:00 UTC on rack r150. If canary is clean proceed with production cohorts.

maya: Tweak proposal: temporarily reduce `batch.max_inflight` from 8 -> 6 and limit `batch.timeout_ms` by 20% for affected hosts to reduce retransmits. We'll revert after cooldown.

ops-bot: Runbook created: run/7577770000-tor-fw. Manual approval before first cohort.

sre-bot: Monitoring hooks set: `link.flap.rate.apac_east1`, `gpu.eviction.rate.apac_east1`, `latency.p95.apac_east1`. Pager if flap>0.5% for 3m or evictions>0.3%.

maya: Customer comms: short advisory to customers in apac-east1, mention possible p95 blips and that Dedicated pools are out-of-scope. Drafting now.

finance-bot: Estimated cost if cross-region spill needed: ~$620 per cohort. In-region warmbackfill estimated ~$120 per cohort.

li: After uncordon run targeted kv-sync:
```
internal-sync --prefix=hot_100 --concurrency=120 --rate=200/s
```
Gate per-rack and verify no edge overload.

maya: Preflight call 21:40 UTC in #eng-infra. Please ack availability.

ash: ack

li: ack

maya: ok. Will post status page entry and start canary at 21:00.
